jurisdictions.name: United States (VisaScreen)
jurisdictions.notes: HRSA minimums for exams taken on or after May 12, 2026; earlier exams are certified under the old list (OET C+ in L/R/W, B in Speaking). TruMerit does not accept at-home tests, and scores must be sent directly by the test provider.

jurisdictions.name: Canada – Ontario
jurisdictions.validity: Test written within 2 years of registering
jurisdictions.notes: All components must be met in one complete attempt. IELTS General Training is also accepted, and an IELTS One Skill Retake within 60 days replaces that skill's score.

jurisdictions.name: Canada – British Columbia
jurisdictions.body: BCCNM (assessment by Inspire Global Assessments for IENs who applied after Jan 31, 2023)
jurisdictions.validity: Evidence no more than 2 years old
jurisdictions.notes: BCCNM states OET as grades (L B, R C+, W C+, S B); the numbers here are the lowest score in each grade. IELTS, OET and PTE must be taken in person.

jurisdictions.name: Canada – Alberta
jurisdictions.body: College of Registered Nurses of Alberta (CRNA)
jurisdictions.validity: Results expire 2 years from the test date (CRNA may consider older results if you tell them)
jurisdictions.notes: CRNA accepts only CELBAN and IELTS Academic; OET is not accepted. Non-test routes (e.g., nursing education in English) may apply.

jurisdictions.name: Australia

combine.window: Up to two sittings no more than 12 months apart
combine.floors: IELTS: overall 7 in each sitting and no component below 6.5 in either sitting. OET: each sitting must include all four parts, with no score below L320, R340, W350, S350 in either sitting.

jurisdictions.validity: Results generally under 2 years old when you apply (for two sittings, counted from the earlier sitting)
jurisdictions.notes: Scores for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026; tests on or before 22 April 2026 use the old minimums (OET B/B/C+/B). At-home and remotely proctored tests are not accepted, except OET on computer at a test center.

jurisdictions.name: New Zealand

combine.window: Within 12 months of the first sitting

jurisdictions.validity: All sittings within the 3 years before you apply
jurisdictions.notes: Only OET and IELTS Academic are accepted. Online computer-based tests are not accepted; computer tests at an approved center are (including OET on computer, whose Speaking part is hosted online).

oetGood: Built for healthcare: OET is designed for 12 healthcare professions, and its tasks reflect real workplace tasks.
Writing and Speaking are specific to your profession: nurses write a nursing letter (such as a referral or discharge letter) and do nurse–patient role-plays.
Listening and Reading use healthcare workplace material, so clinical experience helps you understand the content.
Accepted for nurses in the U.S. (VisaScreen), Australia, New Zealand, Ontario and British Columbia.
ieltsGood: Widely accepted: IDP says IELTS is accepted by more than 13,500 organizations in over 140 countries.
Accepted by all six destinations here, including Alberta, which does not accept OET.
General academic content: no clinical knowledge is needed, which can help if you have been away from practice.
IELTS One Skill Retake (within 60 days) is accepted by Ontario and Australia, so you can retake one skill instead of the whole test.
Ontario also accepts IELTS General Training.

U.S.: TruMerit ties the new minimums to exams 'taken on or after May 12, 2026' but does not explicitly define this as the test date.

BC: BCCNM states OET as grades only. The numbers (B=350, C+=300) are the lowest score in each OET grade band, not numbers BCCNM publishes. BC does not say whether sittings can be combined. Inspire Global Assessments' own test list was not found or checked.
Alberta: CRNA does not say whether sittings can be combined.
NZ: NCNZ sets no floor per sitting and does not say whether sittings must be of the same test (sameTest null). Check with NCNZ before combining OET and IELTS.

OET grade bands: the official OET results page lists each grade's top score (A 500, B 440, C+ 340, C 290, D 190, E 90) in 10-point steps. Lower bounds come from that and from IDP's table. oet.com could not be fetched on 2026-10-09.

briefCorrections: US OET 'C+ (300) in L/R/W and B (350) Speaking' is the old rule (May 24, 2022 to May 12, 2026). For exams on or after May 12, 2026: Listening 320, Reading 340, Writing 350, Speaking 360 (HRSA; TruMerit).
US 'no clubbing' is not stated on HRSA or TruMerit pages. Mark it unverified and do not show it as a rule.
Canada IELTS 'L7.5/R6.5/W7/S7' is wrong for Ontario, BC and Alberta. All three require overall 7.0, Listening 7.0, Reading 6.5, Writing 6.5, Speaking 7.0 (CNO, BCCNM, CRNA).

Australia OET 'B in all four' is wrong. Before 23 Apr 2026 it was L B, R B, W C+, S B. For tests from 23 Apr 2026 it is L350, R360, W350, S360, so a Reading or Speaking score of 350 (grade B) is no longer enough (Ahpra accepted tests).

Australia clubbing '2 tests within 6 months' is out of date. Now it is up to two sittings of the same test, no more than 12 months apart, with floors in each sitting (OET L320/R340/W350/S350; IELTS overall 7 each sitting and no component below 6.5) (Ahpra accepted tests; Ahpra FAQ).
NZ IELTS Writing 6.5 is correct (L/R/S 7.0). NZ OET is L/R/S 350 and Writing 300 (NCNZ).

NZ clubbing 'within 12 months' is correct (12 months from the first sitting, and all sittings within 3 years before applying). But 'no subtest < 6.5/300' is not on the NCNZ page. NCNZ states no floor per sitting, so remove it (NCNZ).
